decision: HOLD: new reason fallback defect remains; inherited disabled pressed contract gap also requires resolution or explicit coordinator disposition.

findings.problem: status_reason chooses the pointed item before checking whether it supplies an eligible reason. A disabled pointed row without a reason suppresses the still-highlighted disabled cursor row explanation. Frozen OptionList::status instead performs pointed.and_then(reason).or_else(highlighted.and_then(reason)).
findings.reproduction: Public Consumer: Run enabled, Commit.reason("Choose a target"), Unavailable.disabled(true); skip_disabled(false), clear_on_leave(true). Down highlights Commit and displays its reason; mouse Move to Unavailable row at (4,3) leaves cursor=1 but removes the reason.
findings.required_fix: Resolve an eligible nonempty disabled reason for the pointed row first, then fall back to the visible highlighted row. Add the real-runtime regression including a reasonless disabled row and an empty reason.

findings.classification: pre-existing behavior, unfulfilled explicit increment contract
findings.problem: draw_row inserts PRESSED for the runtime pressed target even when item.disabled. Pointer Down on an unavailable row changes its full-cell appearance to pressed white/black BOLD. The new reason API automatically disables items, but its tests only verify nonactivation after release and miss the held frame.
findings.reproduction: Public Consumer: hover disabled Commit row then mouse Down at (4,2); complete row cells change from highlighted blue to pressed white/black BOLD. Identical disabled(bool) probe also fails at 6841 base, so this is not claimed as a newly introduced regression.
findings.required_fix: Keep disabled pointer controls out of pressed styling/capture mechanics at the responsible shared layer, with held/drag/cancel regression proof. Coordinate the effect on existing default disabled-menu frames explicitly rather than silently folding a broader change into this increment.

checks.scope: Two independent public API/runtime reason probes, captured before adding separate default comparison target.

default_compatibility.result: 32 complete Cell-field snapshots equal byte for byte, with direct press-before-release selection behavior also unchanged.
default_compatibility.limits: These snapshots contain all ratatui Cell debug fields; cursor/focus/terminal modes are not included in this comparison and are not asserted as fully proven.

rejected_hypotheses.hypothesis: Unconditional hover_suppressed changes default no-reason keyboard/hover frames.
rejected_hypotheses.disposition: Not reproduced. Paired full-cell event sequence is identical.

rejected_hypotheses.hypothesis: A hovered row must have an identical entire appearance before and after Home.
rejected_hypotheses.disposition: Invalid probe: the keyboard cursor/focus legitimately changes. Initial assertions failed both revisions and were preserved as rejected fixture evidence in default-before-nextest.log/default-after-nextest.log and initial-default.rs copies.

source_review.api_compatibility: Added fields are private; no existing public struct literals or action enums broken. Borrowed MenuItem::reason and const getters/builders preserve lifetime/configuration ownership. MenuBar padding repair restores label painting through its inset title rect; native existing padding regression test is green.
source_review.ownership: Menu owns reason selection/rendering; no app object, replay assets, hidden controls, extra renderer, unsafe code, or new runtime state system introduced by reviewed diff. HELP is decoration and style/slot API is reused.
source_review.theme_scope: Only MENU DEFAULT HELP muted recipe added; no global tokens or unrelated family edits.

coverage_gaps: No real CLI paired application capture or Capsule adoption; no product parity acceptance.
Complete overlay-stack/inactive HELP styling, arbitrary all-disabled/open-close/dynamic-data lifecycle, exhaustive narrow heights and profile/style combinations were not independently proven.
Default paired comparison covers a fixed 40x6 public test consumer, not every existing menu flow or terminal size.
Before reason API is absent, so the new fallback regression is a current behavior failure against the frozen contract, not a same-source executable pre-feature proof.
